claim: Anthropic's RSP v2.0 defines catastrophic risk as a risk of 'large-scale devastation' from advanced AI, comprising CBRN, critical infrastructure, autonomous replication, and manipulation categories.

source.excerpt: Catastrophic risk is a risk that AI systems can cause large-scale devastation... our RSP focuses on the most severe potential harms from advanced AI.

claim: Anthropic's RSP v2.0 commits to ASL-3 protections before training any model that crosses capability thresholds for catastrophic misuse.

source.excerpt: We commit to not deploying any AI model that crosses capability thresholds triggering ASL-3 protections until those protections are in place.

provenance.context: Anthropic RSP v2.0, §2.2 ASL-3 commitment. URL: https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/870b1c65b2d0501d7f43e1dc4853e4d37.pdf

claim: Anthropic's RSP v2.0 escalates protections to ASL-4 for models capable of catastrophic harm at scale, with enhanced security and oversight.

source.excerpt: ASL-4 protections will require: substantially enhanced security controls... external red-teaming... and ongoing oversight mechanisms.

provenance.context: Anthropic RSP v2.0, §2.3 ASL-4 framework. URL: https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/870b1c65b2d0501d7f43e1dc4853e4d37.pdf

claim: Anthropic published its first Risk Report in May 2025, covering Claude Opus 4's CBRN capabilities and ASL-2 protections.

source.excerpt: This is our first Risk Report. It covers Claude Opus 4 and our ASL-2 protections.

claim: Anthropic operated a Frontier Red Team throughout 2024-2025, conducting pre-deployment evaluations for CBRN and cyber capabilities on Claude 3.5 and Claude 4 models.

source.excerpt: Our Frontier Red Team has been operational since 2024. We conduct pre-deployment evaluations for CBRN, cyber, and autonomy capabilities.

provenance.context: Anthropic Frontier Red Team update (Mar 2025). URL: https://www.anthropic.com/news/frontier-red-team-update-2025

claim: Anthropic maintains a responsible disclosure policy for vulnerabilities in their systems, including jailbreak-resistance and model robustness reports.

source.excerpt: We welcome reports of vulnerabilities in our safety systems. Researchers can submit findings through our disclosure program.

claim: Anthropic's Constitutional AI methodology, refined through 2024-2025, uses a constitution of principles to guide model behavior, with public documentation of the principles.

source.excerpt: Our Constitutional AI methodology guides model behavior through a set of publicly-documented principles. The methodology has been refined through 2024-2025.

provenance.context: Anthropic Constitutional AI paper (Feb 2025 update). URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.08073

claim: Anthropic submitted a Winter 2025 FLI Index survey response, addressing transparency gaps including whistleblower protections and external evaluations.

source.excerpt: Anthropic submitted a response to the FLI Winter 2025 survey, providing additional transparency on whistleblower protections, external evaluation partnerships, and risk management processes.

provenance.context: FLI AI Safety Index Winter 2025 Appendix A (Survey responses). URL: https://futureoflife.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/AI-Safety-Index-Report_131225_Full_Report_Digital.pdf
